<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1929776_compli_0.CPMPipeline</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>CPMPipeline</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var CPMPipeline = Class.create();
CPMPipeline.prototype = {
  initialize: function() {},

  // Each phase is isolated: a failure is logged and the next phase still runs
  run: function() {
    var phases = [
      ['sync',    function() { new CPMSync().run(); }],
      ['states',  function() { new CPMPosture().rollStates(); }],
      ['posture', function() { new CPMPosture().recalculate(); }],
      ['notify',  function() { new CPMNotify().run(); }]
    ];
    phases.forEach(function(phase) {
      try {
        phase[1]();
        gs.info('[CPM] ' + phase[0] + ' completed');
      } catch (e) {
        gs.error('[CPM] ' + phase[0] + ' failed: ' + e.message);
      }
    });
  },

  type: 'CPMPipeline'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-24 11:52:21</sys_created_on><sys_id>645836fe73001310a621f2024ab8b798</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CPMPipeline</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Compliance Posture Mapper" source="x_1929776_compli_0">f7756d0a738c9310a621f2024ab8b707</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Compliance Posture Mapper">f7756d0a738c9310a621f2024ab8b707</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_645836fe73001310a621f2024ab8b798</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-24 11:52:21</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
